svg.title: Prudhvi Krovvidi. A little more about me.
svg.desc: A looping point-cloud reveal: scattered points gather into a sphere, form a Duke 390-inspired motorcycle, a powerlifting barbell and a black-coffee cup, then resolve into Prudhvi Krovvidi. Each 10-second cycle holds the finished name before restarting. Reduced-motion settings show the finished name immediately.
